description: Email the booking's client their assigned driver's first name + phone. Pass `email` if you already have the client's address (e.g. from Zeplan get-booking); otherwise WP looks it up on the booking post. Returns { sent, to (masked), client_phone }. Voice agent use.

booking_id.description: Booking / reservation ID (= the WP payment post ID).

driver_first_name.description: Driver's FIRST NAME only (never last name/company).

email.description: Client email to send to. If omitted, WP looks it up on the booking post.

name: send_driver_contact
